summary: Iteration 14: tested portal 'Mis citas' reschedule calendar. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (slots endpoint auth 401/404, info w/o date, own slots incl. self time, others when own stylist blocked, no-slots + next_days on closed Sunday, holiday, reschedule same/other stylist persists with reschedule_count+1, max reached -> allowed=false + POST 409, <12h -> allowed=false). Frontend: no native date/time inputs; dialog with rule text and Spanish calendar (octubre 2026, lu..do); past days and holiday disabled; own slots, others (with stylist names + message), no-slots with next-day buttons that load that date; confirm label 'Confirmar <date> <time>', toast 'Cita reprogramada para el ...', dialog closes, card updated; cancel closes; not-allowed state hides calendar; mobile 390px dialog fits (width 390, scrollable). One functional UX bug: calendar month does not follow jumps to another month.

minor.issue: 'allowed' doesn't check appointment status (cancelled/completed appts would report allowed=true); only matters if called directly. Calendar also doesn't know branch closed weekdays (e.g. Zona 10 Sunday enabled, then shows no-slots) - could return closed weekdays in info to disable them.

ui_bugs.issue: Calendar month is uncontrolled: clicking a resched-next-<date> button (or an outside day) in a different month (e.g. from Nov 1 -> 2026-11-02) loads the slots but the calendar stays on 'octubre 2026' with no visible selected day. Fix: add month state (const [month,setMonth]=useState()) and pass month/onMonthChange to <Calendar>, setMonth(parse(date)) whenever date changes.

issues: In not-allowed state the disabled 'Elija un horario' confirm button is still shown; hide it
resched-others list can be very long (38 buttons interleaved Diego/Lucía); consider grouping by stylist
Portal 'Confirmar' button on appointment card lacks data-testid

action_items: Control Calendar month in RescheduleDialog so jumps to next-month dates navigate the view
Optional: hide confirm button when not allowed; disable branch-closed weekdays in calendar; check status in allowed
